name: PolarDB-X
tagline: Alibaba's open-source, MySQL-compatible shared-nothing distributed SQL with Paxos and columnar indexes.
description: PolarDB-X is Alibaba Cloud's distributed edition of PolarDB, descended from the DRDS sharding middleware that ran Taobao's Double-11 traffic. Stateless compute nodes (written in Java) parse MySQL-dialect SQL and route it to data nodes based on a MySQL fork with X-Paxos replication, while global secondary indexes and clustered columnar indexes keep cross-shard lookups and analytics workable. The engine is open source under Apache 2.0 and installable with Kubernetes operators, and it is also sold as a managed service. It is a credible alternative to TiDB and OceanBase for MySQL shops that need horizontal scale, mainly within the Alibaba ecosystem.

pricing.notes: Open-source edition is free to self-host; managed PolarDB-X on Alibaba Cloud is pay-as-you-go or subscription.

scale.notes: Hash/range partitioning with automatic rebalancing; data nodes use three-replica X-Paxos; cross-region via read-only instances and CDC.

strengths: MySQL-compatible SQL and a MySQL-format global binlog for downstream tools
Global secondary indexes avoid scatter-gather lookups on non-shard keys
Clustered columnar indexes add analytical scans without a separate warehouse
X-Paxos replicas give RPO=0 within a region
Apache 2.0 open source with Kubernetes operator
weaknesses: Ecosystem and docs centered on Alibaba Cloud and Chinese-language community
No triggers; some MySQL features behave differently across shards
More moving parts (CN, DN, GMS, CDC, columnar) than single-node MySQL
Version numbering and release cadence of the open-source edition are hard to track
useCases: Consolidating sharded MySQL into one logical database
notIdealFor: Teams outside the Alibaba ecosystem wanting a large Western community
